### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Estimate a scalar derivative using a forward finite difference approximation, serving as the foundational verification step in building an automatic differentiation engine from scratch.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def autograd_l01_finite_difference_derivative(f_val_plus: float, f_val_center: float, h: float = 1e-5) -> float:
    return round((f_val_plus - f_val_center) / h, 6)
```
